# opnsense_caddy_subdomain (Resource)

Subdomains of a wildcard Caddy domain (**Services ▸ Caddy Web Server ▸ Reverse Proxy ▸ Subdomains**, plugin `os-caddy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_caddy_reverse_proxy" "wildcard" {
  from_domain = "*.example.com"
  description = "wildcard"
}

resource "opnsense_caddy_subdomain" "grafana" {
  reverse     = opnsense_caddy_reverse_proxy.wildcard.id
  from_domain = "grafana.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_domain` (String) Enter a subdomain. For example, "opn.example.com" if the wildcard domain is "*.example.com". All subdomains use the same ports and protocols as their parent wildcard domain.
- `reverse` (String) Select a wildcard domain for this subdomain.

### Optional

- `accesslist` (String) Select an Access List to restrict access to this subdomain. If unset, any local or remote client is allowed access. Defaults to ``.
- `acme_passthrough` (String) Enter a domain name or IP address. The HTTP-01 challenge will be redirected to that destination. This enables an ACME Client behind Caddy to serve "/.well-known/acme-challenge/" on port 80. Caddy will reverse proxy the HTTP-01 challenge for this subdomain. Defaults to ``.
- `basicauth` (Set of String) Select Users to restrict access to this subdomain. Basic Auth matches after Access Lists. If unset, any user is allowed access. Defaults to `[]`.
- `client_auth_mode` (String) "request" - Ask clients for a certificate, but allow even if there isn't one; do not verify it. "require" - Require clients to present a certificate, but do not verify it. "verify_if_given" - Ask clients for a certificate; allow even if there isn't one, but verify it if there is. "require_and_verify" - Require clients to present a valid certificate that is verified. One of `request`, `require`, `verify_if_given`. Defaults to ``.
- `client_auth_trust_pool` (Set of String) Choose multiple CAs or self-signed certificates from "System - Trust - Authorities". Client Auth is activated as soon as at least one certificate has been chosen. Important: Certificate revocation lists are not evaluated. If you need granular control, provide individual self-signed certificates for each device, and unset them to block access. Though keep in mind that if no certificate is left in this field, Client Auth will be deactivated. Defaults to `[]`.
- `description` (String) Enter a description for this subdomain. Defaults to ``.
- `dyn_dns` (Boolean) Enable or disable Dynamic DNS. Requires a "DNS Provider" in "General Settings". The DNS records of this subdomain will be automatically updated. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this subdomain. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Caddy subdomain.
